main_text.p: familiæ eius exitus ? audi tonantem Prophetam: fCap.14.{f} Ecce ego inducam malum super domum Ieroboam, & percutiam de Ieroboam mingentem ad parietem, & clausum & nouissimum in Israel, & mundabo reliquias domus Ieroboam, sicut mun-dari solet fimus vsque ad purum: qui mortui fuerint de Ieroboam in ciuitate, comedent eos canes; qui autem mortui fuerint in a-gro, vorabunt eos aues cœli, & vnus solum de filijs ipsius, in sepulchrum inferetur, quia Dominus loquutus est. Neque in Scrip-tura deinceps nominatur, nisi summa cum ignominia, & nominis fœtore, semperq; illum sibi titulum annexum gerit, tanquam captivus compedes, aut catenas: Ieroboam filius Nebat, qui peccare fecit Israel. Postremo, filius eius Nebad, cum duobus tantum annis regnasset, à BaasahgCap.15.* Baalsh Regis ida interfectus. * interfectus est, qui etiam percussit omnem domum Ieroboam, nec demisit, ne vnam quidem animam de semine eius; nec sic tamen multus ipse abibit Baasah, audi rursus è cœlo tubam: hCap.16.{h} Ecce ego demetam posteriora Baasah, & posteriora domus eius, & faciam domum tuam sicut domum Ieroboam filij.

page.notes: The text runs from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The marginal "g" note (Cap.15) is printed beside "à Baasah", but no matching reference mark g is visible in the text; the asterisk after Baasah is printed in the text and is transcribed as is. The margin line "* Baalsh Regis ida interfectus." is partly unclear; "Baalsh" may be a misprint or a different word, but it is read as printed. The catchword "filij" is doubtful and is read from the lower right corner. The "fCap" and "hCap" reference marks in the margin are read as printed and are linked to the text marks f and h.
